4 days till ScottyCon! Friendly reminder that ticket preorders close tomorrow!
4 days till ScottyCon! Pre-registration closes tonight!

A huge thank you to our incredible sponsors for their generous support of ScottyCon 2025! Their assistance is integral to bringing ScottyCon to life, and we are beyond grateful for their contributions. Some of our sponsors will be tabling in Merchant’s Hall. Please come and visit them in Wiegand Gymnasium between 11 AM-8 PM! Additionally, some vendors will offer game, console, and card trade-ins. if you are interested, please be sure to bring your items to our event!

Are you interested in promoting your business and/or hosting a table at ScottyCon? We have released our updated sponsorship guide for ScottyCon 2026! Please peruse our booklet for information on our price tiers and associated benefits. We are accepting sponsors until late February, so contact us with any sponsorship ideas or inquiries!
https://www.scottycon.com/sponsors

Carnegie Mellon’s Giving Day is today! ScottyCon is fundraising for our upcoming 2026 convention. We tremendously appreciate donations of all amounts, and all support will directly benefit our organization in improving the experience and programming for attendees!
Please support our organization at the following link:
https://givenow.cmu.edu/schools/CarnegieMellonUniversity/giving-cmu-day-2025/pages/student-organizations/scottycon

Come peruse the 100+ student artists selling their creations at ScottyCon on March 28th! The Merchant’s Hall will host our artist alley and independent vendors. It will be held in Wiegand Gymnasium from 11am to 8pm. Tickets are live now on scottycon.com.
Experience Summer Wars on the big screen! Join us for movie screenings at McConomy Auditorium during ScottyCon. Admission is included with your ticket.

🌸 Guest Announcement! 🌸
@feebeechanchibi is coming to ScottyCon 2026! Your favorite 2.5D fairytale idol, multi-talented singer-songwriter, voice actress, and streamer will be joining us as our Guest of Honor. More details coming soon!

Haven’t gotten enough anime and gaming with ScottyCon? 🎮

Check out Tekko, Pennsylvania’s largest anime convention! With a whole weekend packed full of anime, gaming, and pop culture fun, Tekko has something for everyone. Get your tickets today: 
https://www.eventeny.com/events/ticket/?id=13141
Join us for our guest panel at ScottyCon 2026! @feebeechanchibi will be taking the stage for a live performance, followed by a Q&A session. We hope to see you there!

Just a reminder that our master application closes in one more week‼️ To aspiring panelists, performers, and club collaborators—submit your application today!
https://bit.ly/SC26MasterApp

Our team is hard at work gearing up for ScottyCon 2026! We are happy to announce that our master application has just opened. To aspiring panelists, performers, and club collaborators-please check out the link below! We will continue updating our website as applications release. And mark your calendars for March 28, 2026!
https://bit.ly/SC26MasterApp

🛍️ ScottyCon 2025 Exclusive Merch 🛍️
Excited for ScottyCon? Check out our limited merch lineup for this year! Pick them up in Wiegand Gymnasium on March 29th. Grab them before they run out! Special thanks to our commissioned artists for their amazing designs!
ScottyCon is only 5 days away! Have you grabbed your tickets yet?

ScottyCon needs YOU! Volunteers are crucial for ensuring that ScottyCon is run smoothly. Volunteers who sign up for 3+ will get free entry, a free staff t-shirt, and free food! Anyone is welcome to apply, regardless of experience or skill level.

Apply now: https://bit.ly/volunteerSC26

ScotyCon 2025 is happy to present the critically acclaimed movie adaptation of Tatsuki Fujimoto’s one-shot Look Back. Tune in on March 29th for the emotionally gripping story of the overly confident Fujino and shut-in Kyomoto! We will have three showings in McConomy Auditorium at 11 AM, 3 PM, and 8 PM.

🔸Special Guest Event: Panel Discussion & MV Showcase 🔸

Join us for our special guest panel featuring Sheeno Mirin and StudioGnu! In this panel, they will discuss interdisciplinary approaches to music and technology, as well as insights into Vocaloid culture from a creator’s perspective.

We will also be hosting a music video showcase highlighting the works of Sheeno Mirin and StudioGnu, beginning 15 minutes before the panel!

Thank you for attending ScottyCon 2026! Please take a moment to complete our exit survey. All entries submitted by April 8th will be entered to win a badge to Tekko!

https://bit.ly/SC26Exit
Tickets for ScottyCon 2026 are officially on sale! Preorders are $8 for CMU students and $12 for the general public. Get yours now at https://scottycon.com!

Today is ScottyCon!
Plan out your day using the ScottyCon web app: https://scottycon-guide.com
Notifications will be pushed to the web app for any scheduling changes.

TODAY IS SCOTTYCON! There's still time to buy tickets in-person and enjoy our artist alley, panels, performances, and games - pull up!!!

Plan for your day using our interactive guidebook at scottycon-guide.com!
TOMORROW IS SCOTTYCON! Plan for your day using our interactive guidebook at scottycon-guide.com!

We hope you had a wonderful time at ScottyCon! Please fill out our exit survey! You could win a pair of badges to Tekko!

Stop by to hear all about our club and what we do...snacks provided! Hope to see you there!
